title: 第21章 换骨之术可能救人第22章 辞退
content_zh:
柳随风并非老律观之人，而是卞城斩妖司百户。
每年帝流浆夜之后，朝廷都会组织人手，深入灵界，围剿精怪，俗称夏苗，又称校猎。
既是操练兵马，也是未雨绸缪，削弱精怪实力，更是积攒修行资粮。
卞城斩妖司亦在此列。
据柳随风所言，此番围剿，斩获颇丰，却也折损不少。
其中，便有诸多珍贵战马，伤了腿脚，药石无医。
按照惯例，也只能报损，采购新马。
说来也是凑巧，柳随风采购战马时，与韩祁森闲聊一二，意外得知烟霞驹之事，这才心生希冀，匆匆而来。
面对朝廷斩妖司的邀请，陈知白自然没有拒绝的理由，欣然应允。
除了他之外，柳随风也顺道邀请倪紫君随行。
陈知白会换骨，可不会治病。
上次治疗烟霞驹，既然是两人通力配合，这次保险起见，还是两人同往最好。
倪紫君闻言，眉头微蹙：“此事妾身还需请示一下刑长老，还请几位稍等一二。”
说罢，对陈知白二人略一颔首，便转身离开兽舍，径直往妙手堂深处行去。
待穿过几重门户，来到一间静室外。
她抬手轻叩门扉。
“进。”
室内传来一道略显低沉的声音。
倪紫君推门而入，药香扑鼻而来。
目之所及，静室陈设简单，仅有一榻一几，几上堆着几片玉简。

形长老正盘膝而坐，闭目冥想。
造化道，初玄符箓为【医药箓】，入玄则为【服食箓】，据说，可服百草，食菁华，采补生机，而夺造化。
想来刑长老，又在炼化草木精华。
“弟子倪紫君，见过刑长老。”倪紫君躬身行礼。
“嗯。”
刑长老依旧双眸微阖：“何事？”
“长老，可还记得半个月前断腿的烟霞驹？”
倪紫君顿了顿又道：
“弟子刚刚得知，那烟霞驹换骨之后，已然安然无恙。今日，韩祁森因此引荐卞城斩妖司柳百户前来，欲请陈知白为营中伤马换骨，弟子有心劝诫，奈何柳百户心意已决，未能拦下。”
刑长老眼皮微动，终是睁开一线，眸光沉静：
“移肢换脏本就是在赌天命，烟霞驹能活，或许是巧合，也或许是尚未发作。他们不懂医术，只看眼前，便随他们去罢，多死几匹，自然就明白何为人力有时而穷，天道恒常。你既然已提醒在前，也算尽了本分，不必再多言。”
“是！”
倪紫君想了想又道：“那柳百户还想请弟子同往，诊治寒毒。”
“斩妖司的面子，总要给的，你便随他们走一遭吧！”
刑长老顿了顿，又叮嘱道：“记住，只治寒毒，换骨成败，与你无关，亦非你之责。”
“弟子明白。”
倪紫君再拜，悄然退出静室。
她安排好陈知白顶岗人选，一行人随即离开老律观，径直往山下卞城行去。
卞城斩妖司，设于城东三十里处，隐于草木，背靠山峦。远远望去，仿佛一座行宫堡垒，匍卧山野。
content_en:
Liu Suifeng was not from Laoluguan, but from Baihu, the Demon Slayer Division in Biancheng.
Every year after the Emperor's Bloody Night, the imperial court would organize manpower to go deep into the spiritual world to encircle and suppress the spirits and monsters, commonly known as Xia Miao, also known as school hunting.
It is not only to train soldiers and horses, but also to prepare for a rainy day, weaken the strength of spirits, and to accumulate spiritual resources.
The Biancheng Demon Slayer Division is also included in this list.
According to Liu Suifeng, this encirclement and suppression campaign resulted in a lot of gains, but also a lot of losses.
Among them, there are many precious war horses with injured legs and feet, and no medicine or stone can cure them.
According to the usual practice, one can only report losses and purchase new horses.
It was a coincidence that when Liu Suifeng was purchasing war horses, he chatted with Han Qisen and unexpectedly learned about the Yanxia Colt. Then he became hopeful and came in a hurry.
Faced with the invitation from the Imperial Demon Slayer Division, Chen Zhibai naturally had no reason to refuse and readily agreed.
In addition to him, Liu Suifeng also invited Ni Zijun to accompany him.
Chen Zhibai can change bones, but he can't cure diseases.
Since the two of them worked together to treat Yanxiaju last time, it would be best for them to go together this time to be on the safe side.
Ni Zijun frowned slightly when he heard this: "I still need to ask Elder Xing for instructions on this matter, so please wait a moment."
After saying that, he nodded briefly to Chen Zhibai and the others, then turned around and left the animal house, heading straight to the depths of Miaoshou Hall.
After passing through several doors, we came to a quiet room.
She raised her hand and knocked lightly on the door.
"Come in."
A slightly deep voice came from the room.
Ni Zijun pushed the door open and entered, and the scent of medicine hit his nostrils.
As far as the eye could see, the quiet room was simply furnished, with only a couch and a few tables piled with jade slips.
Elder Xing was sitting cross-legged and meditating with his eyes closed.
In the Tao of Creation, the talisman in the early Xuan Dynasty is the "Medicine Urn", and in the Xuan Dynasty it is the "Eating Urn". It is said that one can take herbs and eat essences to replenish vitality and seize good fortune.
I think Elder Xing is refining the essence of plants and trees again.
"Disciple Ni Zijun, I have met Elder Xing." Ni Zijun bowed and saluted.
"Yeah."
Elder Xing still closed his eyes slightly: "What's the matter?"
"Elder, do you still remember the Yanxiaju whose leg was broken half a month ago?"
Ni Zijun paused and said:
"The disciple has just learned that the Yanxia horse is safe and sound after its bones were reborn. Today, Han Qisen recommended Liu Baihu, the Demon Slayer Division of Biancheng, to come and ask Chen Zhibai to rebone the horse that was injured in the camp. The disciple wanted to dissuade him, but Liu Baihu was determined and could not stop him."
Elder Xing's eyelids moved slightly, and finally he opened them, his eyes calm:
"Removing limbs and replacing organs is a gamble on destiny. The Yanxia Colt can survive, maybe it's a coincidence, or maybe it hasn't happened yet. They don't know medical skills, they just look at what's in front of them, and let them go. If a few more horses die, they will naturally understand why manpower is sometimes poor, but the law of heaven is constant. Since you have reminded me in advance, you have done your duty, and there is no need to say more."
"Yes!"
Ni Zijun thought for a while and then said: "Liu Baihu also wants to invite his disciples to come with him to diagnose and treat cold poison."
"You have to give the Demon Slayer Division some face, so just let them go!"
Elder Xing paused and then warned: "Remember, we only treat cold poison. The success or failure of the bone regeneration has nothing to do with you and is not your responsibility."
"Disciple understands."
Ni Zijun bowed again and quietly exited the quiet room.
She arranged for Chen Zhibai to be selected for the post, and the group immediately left Laoluguan and went straight to Bian City at the foot of the mountain.
Bian Cheng Demon Slayer Division was located thirty miles east of the city, hidden among the vegetation and backed by mountains. Looking from a distance, it looks like a palace and fortress lying in the mountains.
